# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems. Email **acm@bmsce.ac.in** with
the subject line "Security: bmsce.acm.org", a description of the issue, and steps to
reproduce it. We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 working days and will keep you
updated until it is resolved.

## Scope

- The public website (bmsce.acm.org) and its API.
- The admin panel and its API.

Out of scope: third-party services the site links to or embeds (Web3Forms,
Cloudinary, social networks).
